requirement: A non-READB entry transmits FBYTE on the wire; decoded 8-bit wire byte must equal FBYTE, and START precedes it iff START flag set.
READB reads exactly R wire bytes, R=FBYTE, FBYTE 0 means 256; FBYTE is a count not a wire byte.
First R-1 read bytes ACKed; final byte NACKed unless RCONT, in which case ACKed (RCONT boundary).
assumption: ninth bit sampled at SCL rise

requirement: Exactly one RX per read wire byte, in wire order, data equal to decoded 8-bit byte; RX may precede the ninth bit; no extra/duplicate RX.
assumption: RX sink accepts every pre rx_valid

requirement: No START is issued for a READB entry (START flag ignored with READB); repeated START only before a START-flagged write.
STOP issued after an entry with STOP flag and only then; no wire data or START between that entry and STOP.
FMT head mirrors queued entries in order; an entry pops only after processing (write: ninth bit; READB: all R bytes decoded and RX delivered).
assumption: ready is pop after processing, not acceptance; same-row push/flush applied before pre; READB pop after RX delivery is a fixture ordering contract, not an upstream timing guarantee

requirement: Reset clears queue and expectations; pre-reset bytes/RX never satisfy post-reset expectations; transactions do not span reset.
source: interface legal_inputs (reset clears queue and target); registers.md reset defaults
assumption: rst_n async low applied as action

requirement: Unexpected NACK, timeout, arbitration or other controller events are outside this profile and yield pending/unsupported, never pass.
Exact-cycle timing, analog timing, liveness deadlines and timeouts are not checked.
